name: code-evolve/label-filter
description: A small glob-like pattern language for filtering lists of objects by their labels. Parsed to an IR, never compiled to a regex.

code-evolve.publishedNote: Read by site/build.mjs. Packagist has no manifest flag, so this is the only statement of it; flip it when the package is actually submitted, not when it is ready to be. It lives under extra because composer validate refuses an undefined top-level property, which is what kept this manifest unsubmittable.
